Hi Olga,

Thanks for taking the call earlier. We need to move through our security intake quickly for a Q1 procurement decision. Two asks to start:

1) Can Redwood provide the most recent SOC 2 Type II report (or an extract of relevant control areas) plus a signed bridge/temporary attestation we can present to our audit group?

- We can provide a SOC 2 Type II report extract focused on Security + Availability control areas and a signed bridge letter/temporary attestation that covers the period since the last audit. Estimated delivery: 3 business days for the extract + bridge letter PDF (we'll expedite).
- We'll provision read-only access to our Trust Portal (Redwood Trust) for your security team. I need the list of names/emails who need access and whether you prefer SSO (SAML) or invite-by-email.
- A couple of gating items: contract redlines referencing data residency/GDPR or HIPAA-specific BAAs may require legal review; if you have a preferred template let us know.

I've attached a one-page SOC2 summary (SOC2_TypeII_quicksummary.pdf) that highlights scope and audit firm. I'll loop in Karthik on the trust portal provisioning and Ben to confirm legal/attestation signing cadence.

Next steps:
- Jane: send list of portal users and SSO preference.

- Karthik: initiate portal invites and share the invite link.
- Ben: confirm signature workflow for attestation (electronic preferred).

Thanks — talk soon.
